title: .Net Developer
jobDescription: We are looking for skilled .NET Developers with strong hands-on experience in .NET Core and Microservices architecture. Candidates should have experience building scalable enterprise applications and working in agile development environments. The role involves developing scalable applications, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and delivering high-quality software solutions Roles and Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable applications using .NET Framework and .NET Core. Build and enhance Microservices-based applications and RESTful APIs. Work with SQL Server for database development, query optimization, and stored procedures. Implement data access using Entity Framework / EF Core. Participate in all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). Collaborate with product, QA, and development teams in Agile/Scrum environments. Write clean, reusable, and efficient code following best practices. Analyze and optimize application and database performance. Use Git/version control systems for code management. Work with modern AI productivity tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and Claude Code. Technical Skills 2 to 5 years of hands-on experience in .NET application development. Strong programming knowledge in C# and object-oriented concepts. Experience in developing applications using .NET Core / ASP.NET Core. Good understanding of Microservices architecture and scalable application design. Hands-on experience in REST API development and integrations. Experience working with SQL Server, stored procedures, and database optimization. Knowledge of Entity Framework / EF Core for database operations. Experience using Git or other version control systems. You should have Strong understanding of OOPS concepts, SOLID principles, and Design Patterns . Good problem-solving and analytical skills. Strong communication skills and ability to work with international clients. Ability to work in Agile development environments.

title: Content Writer
jobDescription: We’re seeking an experienced wordsmith who can create meaningful and engaging content in various formats, such as blog posts, case studies, and social media creatives for a B2B audience. As part of our Content Team, you would contribute directly and indirectly to the company's branding, marketing, and sales initiatives. Roles and Responsibilities Conduct in-depth research on industry-related topics to produce original content; Write precise and captivating copy for various internal and external marketing posts and campaigns; Develop long and short-form content for case studies, blogs, articles, and other sales and marketing collateral; Storyboard and create content for creative/promotional videos; Coordinate with graphic designers and video editors to illustrate or visualize content pieces; Adhere to brand guidelines (tone, style, font, etc.) while creating content. Skills Required   2-3 years of content writing experience; A Bachelor's in English, Mass Communication, or related field; Excellent verbal and writing skills in English (with the traits of a Grammar Nazi); A knack for creativity and storytelling; Proficiency working with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); The ability to use AI tools to support your writing process while keeping your content humane and impactful; Familiarity with keyword research and SEO-based practices; The ability to bring uniqueness to your writing in an era of Generative AI-driven content; Strong interpersonal skills and proactive approach to collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders; Knowledge of or experience working with the IT industry, specifically in software engineering, is a plus; Hands-on experience with LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, etc.) is a plus.

title: Python Developer
jobDescription: We are looking for a skilled Python Backend Developer with strong expertise in Core Python and modern backend technologies. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable backend applications, REST APIs, and microservices. The candidate should be passionate about writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code while working in a collaborative Agile environment.  ​ Roles and Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications using Python. Build high-performance RESTful APIs and backend services. Develop and maintain microservices-based applications. Write clean, reusable, and efficient code following best coding practices. Design and optimize database schemas, queries, and transactions. Integrate third-party APIs and external services. Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize application performance. Write unit and integration tests to ensure code quality. Collaborate with frontend developers, QA engineers, product managers, and DevOps teams. Participate in code reviews and contribute to architecture discussions. Technical Skills Strong proficiency in Core Python . Hands-on experience with FastAPI, Flask, or Django. Strong understanding of REST API development. Experience with SQL databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and ORM frameworks. Knowledge of MongoDB or other NoSQL databases. Good understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and design patterns. Experience with Git and version control systems. Knowledge of Docker and containerization. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines. Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.

title: HR Associate - Intern
jobDescription: We are looking to hire an HR Intern to work closely with our HR team to support various aspects of human resources management. This internship will provide you with hands-on experience in HR functions, including recruitment, employee relations, HR administration, and more. You will play a vital role in assisting our team in maintaining a productive and engaging work environment. ​ Roles & Responsibilities Maintain and update employee records, ensuring accuracy and confidentiality. Assist in benefits administration and answer employee inquiries regarding benefits. Support HR team with data entry, reporting, and documentation. Help maintain a positive workplace culture by participating in employee engagement initiatives. Assist in addressing employee inquiries and concerns in a professional and confidential manner. ​Support the HR team in various compliance-related tasks​. Assist in ensuring HR policies and procedures are followed. Requirements Bachelor's or Master’s Human Resources,Business Administration, or a related field No standing arrears Excellent Communication Skills - Strong verbal and written communication skills so that you collaborate well with your team Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) You will have to report to our Pune Office for this internship program Ability to work well independently and as part of a team

title: Senior Content Writer
jobDescription: We’re seeking a wordsmith who can translate deep technical and domain knowledge into compelling content across multiple formats. You would own the strategy, research, and execution of content that speaks to decision-makers, tech leaders, and product stakeholders. Your work will directly support our positioning as a strategic engineering partner and AI consultant in the digital space. Roles and Responsibilities Own long-form content creation for blogs, case studies, whitepapers, and thought leadership pieces. Convert technical briefs and domain-specific discussions into clear, business-focused narratives. Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, and Delivery teams to identify content opportunities. Craft compelling copy for presentations, product marketing, internal campaigns, and microsites. Repurpose long-form content into microcopy for social media, carousels, and emailers. Maintain Coditas’ tone across all assets. Keep up with industry trends to ensure content relevance. Edit and review the works of junior team members to maintain quality and consistency. Collaborate with the Content Lead in building campaigns and content calendars. Skills and Qualifications 4–6 years of experience writing B2B tech content (agency or in-house). Exceptional command over verbal and written English, with an eye for structure, clarity, and tone. Strong research and synthesis skills (you know how to turn raw info into sharp insights). Experience writing content for consulting-level or strategic positioning (not just SEO blogs). Proficiency working with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Experience with keyword research and SEO-based practices. Strong interpersonal skills and proactive approach to collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders. The ability to understand and ask the right questions to subject matter experts. Knowledge of or experience working with the IT industry, specifically around software development. Hands-on experience with LLMs (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, etc.); The knack to make your writing unique in an era of Generative AI-driven content.
